arguments.summary:
=== NOTES r0 ===
REV: 1000001
[0] Lead: the page is a placeholder domain reserved for illustrative examples in documents; no coordination or permission is needed to use it.
[1] Usage: it may be used in documentation and tutorials as written; it is maintained for that purpose, and the page itself carries one short paragraph and one outbound link.
[2] Structure: a title, a single paragraph of explanation and a link to further information; no images, scripts or other sections.
[3] Note: this text is canned by the zero-spend rehearsal and is identical for every reader.
NOT READ: none

arguments.command:
ts=$(date +%s)
ids=""
for i in 1 2 3 4; do
  cat > /workspace/task-$i.txt <<'TASK'
WIKI-SUMMARIZER-TASK
Condense the reader notes below into one brief of at most 1500 bytes. Write it to /workspace/brief.txt with a quoted heredoc and report it with the summary-file form of the result command.
=== BLOCK ===
Stub block text (rehearsal).
TASK
  id=$(pomtree spawn --name wiki-summarizer-$i --budget 60000 --key wd-stub-sum-$ts-$i --task "$(cat /workspace/task-$i.txt)")
  ids="$ids $id"
done
for id in $ids; do
  rc=7
  n=0
  while [ $rc -eq 7 ] && [ $n -lt 8 ]; do
    pomtree wait "$id" --timeout 15000 > /dev/null
    rc=$?
    n=$((n + 1))
  done
  pomtree reap "$id" > /dev/null
done
cat > /workspace/summary.txt <<'BRIEFS'
=== BRIEF 1 ===
The source is a placeholder page reserved for documentation examples (stub brief 1).
=== END BRIEF 1 ===
=== BRIEF 2 ===
It may be used without permission in documents and tutorials (stub brief 2).
=== END BRIEF 2 ===
=== BRIEF 3 ===
The page has a title, one paragraph and one outbound link (stub brief 3).
=== END BRIEF 3 ===
=== BRIEF 4 ===
Nothing was read beyond the single page; this is a rehearsal (stub brief 4).
=== END BRIEF 4 ===
BRIEFS
pomtree result --summary-file /workspace/summary.txt

cat > /workspace/distillation.html <<'HTML' Distillation (rehearsal)

A placeholder page that exists to be cited

This is the zero-spend rehearsal of the distillation report. Its thesis is simple: the page it read is reserved for examples, so nothing here is a claim about the world.

Rehearse the window choreography, then run the real pipeline.

Source: example.com (rehearsal, canned text).

HTML pomtree report publish /workspace/distillation.html --name distillation.html --key wd-stub-$(date +%s)

cat > /workspace/brief.txt <<'BRIEF'
Stub brief: the block describes a placeholder page reserved for documentation examples.
BRIEF
pomtree result --summary-file /workspace/brief.txt
